messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

### Key automotive signaling test capabilities
| Capability | Automotive use case | R&S implementation / option evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 4G/5G network emulation and signaling test platform | Base platform for automotive cellular device and eCall testing over LTE and 5G NR | R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, RF parametric testing and fading propagation conditions [13]. |
| Next Generation eCall over 4G/5G IMS | Validate NG eCall voice and data transmission as emergency calling moves from 2G/3G circuit-switched networks to 4G/5G packet-switched networks | R&S and Qualcomm used R&S CMX500 to verify Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality to EN 17240:2024, including PSAP simulation and NG eCall voice and data transmission [9]. |
| R&S CMX500 + CMX-KA098 for NG eCall | Test 4G/5G NG eCall implementations under realistic network conditions | R&S states that R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [9]; CMX-KA098 is listed as enabling test software for 4G/5G NG eCall and for EN 17240:2024 [41]. |
| Hybrid eCall fallback testing | Validate that vehicles can use IP/IMS-based NG eCall over 4G/5G and automatically fall back to classic circuit-switched 2G/3G eCall when coverage or service quality degrades | Hybrid eCall testing covers reliable operation and fallback between NG eCall and classic CS eCall transport paths [2]; the source states vehicles use IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G and fall back to classic CS eCall 2G/3G when coverage or service quality degrades [3]. |
| EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 eCall compliance support | Support regulatory-oriented testing for hybrid eCall and NG eCall | R&S CMX-KA09x was updated to support EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance [1]; R&S CMX-KA099 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 18052:2025, and R&S CMX-KA098 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 [1]. |
| PSAP scenario simulation | Validate IVS-to-PSAP behavior for emergency call setup, data, voice and callback-related procedures | NG eCall verification used R&S CMX500 to simulate a PSAP and validate implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024 [9]; CMX-KA099 and CMX-KA098 completed PSAP test scenarios for EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 respectively [1]. |
| Trigger, MSD, GNSS and voice-quality validation | Validate core in-vehicle eCall behavior before certification or market launch | Manufacturers need to validate hybrid implementations can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning and provide intelligible voice quality [3]. |
| VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handover and degraded-radio scenarios | Exercise real-world cellular conditions for automotive emergency-call robustness | The listed network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation and various network scenario emulation [6]. |
| Functional tests, protocol conformity tests and type-approval preparation for IVS | Support automotive IVS implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall | cetecom advanced stated the solution is used for functional tests, protocol conformity tests and type-approval of IVS implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall [35]. |
| CEN / ETSI / 3GPP NG eCall conformance coverage | Support NG eCall over NR/LTE test execution against standards and test specifications | The CMX-KA098 / CMX-KF671B capability list covers R&S CMX500 with CMX-KA098 for CEN EN 17240, ETSI TS 103 683, 3GPP eCall over IMS and Time-Warping conformance tests [53]. |
| Detailed NG eCall procedure coverage | Exercise manual, automatic and test eCall, registration, limited service, MSD transfer/update, audio, callback, clear-down and 5GS/LTE eCall-over-IMS cases | CMX-KA098 test scope includes IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual and test eCall; SIM/USIM conformance; network registration; limited service; MSD transfer and update; IPv4/IPv6 MSD transfer; voice link; audio interface verification; PSAP callback; clear-down; and 5GS/NR and LTE/EPS eCall-over-IMS cases [61]. |
| IMS, IP and audio support for eCall | Support the voice, data and in-band modem aspects of NG eCall | CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists CMX-KA110 for IMS tests from EN 17240:2024, CMX-KA401 for TS17240 in-band modem over IP tests, CMX-KA180 for audio codecs and CMX-ZG180 as an external media endpoint for real end-to-end communication [41]. |
| Audio codec and speech-quality tooling | Support voice-link and intelligibility validation in emergency-call scenarios | CMX-KA180 provides audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice calls, including AMR-NB, AMR-WB and EVS; CMX-KA181 adds POLQA for measuring perceived speech quality; CMX-KA401 provides WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA measurements and end-to-end audio delay [18]. |
| Automation, scripting and log analysis | Automate automotive signaling and application test workflows and analyze protocol/instrument messaging | CMX500 provides CMsquares GUI for RF, functional, advanced signaling and protocol tests; CMXmars for message log analysis; CMsequencer for graphical scripting; XLAPI for Python-based scripting; and SCPI for remote control [12]. |
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Automotive need | Confirmed option / specification | Why it matters | Evidence | Gaps / risks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | 4G/5G automotive cellular and eCall signaling platform | LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, fading propagation conditions | Provides the cellular network-emulation base for NG eCall and hybrid eCall work | [13] | Formal automotive use beyond cited eCall contexts is not detailed in the passages. |
| R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA098 | 4G/5G NG eCall testing to EN 17240:2024 | CMX-KA098 enabling test software for 4G/5G NGeCall; CMX-KF671B NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS | Supports NG eCall voice/data, PSAP simulation and EN 17240:2024-oriented testing | [9], [41] | Source does not provide full test case IDs, IMS setup, GNSS setup, software versions or pass/fail details [10]. |
| R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA099 | Hybrid eCall / EN 18052:2025 testing | CMX-KA099 APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL; CMX-KF672B NGECALL TC EN18052 | Supports hybrid eCall scenarios where NG eCall and classic CS eCall paths must interoperate | [40] | Certification source does not provide full PSAP scenario IDs, acceptance criteria or complete test matrix [39]. |
| R&S CMX-KA09x eCall evaluation solution | Updated eCall compliance support | Supports EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance | Covers both hybrid eCall and NG eCall compliance context | [1] | The source does not prove coverage of all possible hybrid eCall test cases [4]. |
| R&S CMX-KA110 / KA401 / KA180 / ZG180 | IMS, in-band modem over IP and audio for NG eCall | KA110 for IMS tests from EN 17240:2024; KA401 for TS17240 in-band modem over IP tests; KA180 audio enabler; ZG180 external media endpoint | Supports the IP/IMS and voice/audio parts of automotive emergency-call validation | [41] | Exact license dependencies, versions and test package details are not fully specified [39]. |
| R&S CMX-KA181 / KA401 | Speech-quality and audio delay measurements | KA181 adds POLQA; KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA and end-to-end audio delay | Useful for validating intelligible voice quality where required by hybrid eCall implementations | [18], [3] | KA181 coverage, standard mapping and commercial availability cannot be inferred from the passages [28]. |
| R&S CMX500 PCT / PCT5-KC625 context | Protocol conformance for eCall over IMS | CTP 1.1.0.1 is covered with protocol test suite PCT5-KC625 in the EN 17240:2024 capability list | Addresses protocol-conformance aspects beyond application-level eCall scripts | [59] | PCT5-KC625 full product details, order number and protocol test suite version are not provided [60]. |
| R&S SMBV100B eCall GNSS configuration | GNSS positioning support for eCall validation | eCall GNSS testing configuration is SMBV100B-based | Addresses the GNSS positioning element that manufacturers must maintain in hybrid eCall implementations | [46], [3] | The hybrid eCall source does not provide GNSS simulation setup details [32]. |
### Scenario cut-in recommendations
| Scenario | Recommended R&S combination supported by passages | Cut-in focus | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| Automated regression and engineering debug | R&S CMX500 with CMsquares, CMXmars, CMsequencer, XLAPI and SCPI | GUI-driven testing, message-log analysis, graphical scripting, Python scripting and remote control | Automotive-specific automation flows are not described in the passages [12]. |
### Limits
The sources also warn not to infer that CMX500 / CMX-KA09x covers all possible hybrid eCall test cases [4], and several items lack full test IDs, acceptance criteria, software versions, setup details or complete equipment dependencies [10], [39], [60], [62].

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 [[EN 18052]] 或 [[EN 17240]] 標準文本摘要。
- 來源未提供正式 certification report、certificate number、測試日期或完整 test matrix。
- 來源未列 national requirements 的國家名稱或版本。
- 不可從新聞稿推論 [[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] 已涵蓋所有 possible hybrid eCall test cases。

Hybrid eCall testing › unresolved
- [[EN 18052]] 的完整標準標題、發布組織與正式版本細節尚未由本來源提供。
- [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 的 amendment A1 細節與發布狀態尚未由本來源提供。
- completed PSAP test scenarios 的 coverage、test IDs、結果細節與 certification scope 未標示。
- 來源未提供 degraded radio conditions、handover 與 voice quality 測試的具體設定。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試情境
來源明示或列出的 network scenarios 包含：

- [[VoNR]]。
- [[VoLTE]]。
- circuit-switched fallback。
- handovers。
- degraded radio conditions。
- real-world mobile network conditions simulation。
- various network scenarios emulation。

來源沒有提供各 scenario 的 test case IDs、channel model、radio profile 或 pass/fail criteria。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification
[[NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]] 中描述的 PR 層級驗證活動：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 NG eCall functionality 符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 與既有 NGeCall / hybrid eCall 頁面的關係
- [[NGeCall over LTE]] 整理 CMW500 與 CMX500 capability lists，本頁只整理 PR 中的 Qualcomm / Snapdragon verification event。
- [[CMX500 NGeCall configuration]] 整理 configuration guide 的 mandatory / optional items，本頁不取代正式 configuration 或 quote。
- [[Hybrid eCall testing]] 以 EN 18052:2025 與 hybrid fallback 為核心；本頁聚焦 EN 17240:2024 NG eCall verification，不描述 classic CS fallback 或 EN 18052 test scope。
- [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 提到 EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 與 cetecom advanced certification testing；本頁來源只提 EN 17240:2024，且未說第三方 certification report。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。

- 來源說實務上車輛會使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G；但在 coverage 或 service quality 降低時，可自動 fallback 到 classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- 製造商需要驗證 hybrid implementations 能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並在 [[VoNR]]、[[VoLTE]] 與 circuit-switched fallback 等多種 network scenarios 下提供 intelligible voice quality。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其 eCall evaluation solution [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] 已更新，以支援 compliance with [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] option completed Public Safety Answering Point scenario tests according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] option completed Public Safety Answering Point scenario tests according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[Thomas Reschka]] 以 [[cetecom advanced]] Senior Technical Consultant 身分表示，該 solution 用於 functional tests、protocol conformity tests，以及 type-approval of [[IVS]] implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall。
- 來源稱 test environment 可 simulation real-world mobile network conditions 並 emulation various network scenarios，用於 certifications 或 new vehicle model market launch 前準備。
- Press contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。

- Automatic trigger / manual trigger / test eCall / network registration / SIP Invite / IMS session establishment / MSD received / callback / clear-down 等測試列入表格。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS：limited service condition 標示 Partly Available*；需要 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS：Call-back answered by IVS in the event of abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 多個測試需要 HMI interaction、Ignition switched OFF、crash simulation、voice link simulation 或 IVS debugging tool，來源明示不完全由 KA09x software 控制。

CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 記錄 [[R&S CMW500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] / [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 的 NGeCall over LTE capability list，狀態為 Oct. 2024；本來源則補充 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] / [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 的 NGeCall over NR/LTE capability list，狀態含 Dec. 2024、May. 2025 與 June 2025 標註。
- 既有 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] 頁只從 [[CMW500 to CMX500OBT_License_Swap_Process]] 得知 CMX-KA098 是 Application test IMS NGeCALL；本來源提供 CMX-KA098 的實際 capability list、最低版本與支援標準範圍。
- 既有 [[R&S CMX500]] 頁依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 整理 CMX500 的一般硬體、FR1/FR2 與 application options；本來源是 NGeCall application / test plan 層的補充，不取代正式 specifications。

CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status › ETSI TS 103 683 V2.1.1
來源將 ETSI TS 103 683 V2.1.1 的 Basic / Advanced / Advanced IVS 測試對應到 CEN EN 17240:2024 的 CTP 項目，並標示 `alternative coverage with CMWrun KF671B`。

可辨識對應包含：

- TD_BAS_01 Initiation of manual eCall → CTP 1.1.8.1。
- TD_BAS_02 Initiation of automatic eCall → CTP 1.1.7.1。
- TD_BAS_03 Initiation of test eCall → CTP 1.1.9.1。
- TD_BAS_04 MSD transfer to PSAP supporting IMS eCall → CTP 1.1.11.1、CTP 1.1.12.1、CTP 1.1.13.1。
- TD_BAS_06 PSAP initiated callback to IVS → CTP 1.1.17.1。
- TD_BAS_08 IVS initiated call clear-down not allowed → CTP 1.1.16.2。
- TD_BAS_09 Verification of audio interfaces of IVS and PSAP → CTP 1.1.15.1。
- TD_BAS_10 MSD update on request from PSAP → CTP 1.1.15.2。
- TD_BAS_15 Negative acknowledgement for initial MSD → CTP 1.1.15.3。
- TD_ADV_01 over IPv4 → CTP 1.1.18.5。
- TD_ADV_02 over IPv6 → CTP 1.1.18.6。
- TD_ADV_04 MSD transfer to PSAP not supporting IMS eCall → CTP 1.1.18.3。
- TD_ADV_05 IMS eCall establishment with IMS emergency registration → CTP 1.1.10.1。
- TD_ADV_06 與 TD_ADV_10 等項目標示 No equivalent in CEN EN 17240。
- TD_ADV_IVS_01 fallback to legacy eCall following busy during call setup 標示 Q2/Q3 2025。
- TD_ADV_IVS_16 Test eCall is not attempted when no networks are available → CTP 1.1.10.5。

CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status › CEN EN 17240:2024
來源列出 CEN EN 17240:2024（區段日期 May. 2024）測試項目，並以 [[R&S CMX500]] >= CSW 2025.0.0.1850 / [[R&S CMX-KA098]] >= V4.3.0-RC8 與 CMWrun [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] / CMWrun >= 1.9.15.37 作為版本基準。

新增或較明確的內容包含：

- CTP 1.1.0.1 改寫為對 ETSI TS 136 523-1、ETSI TS 138 523-1、ETSI TS 134 229-1 與 ETSI TS 134 229-5 的 conformance test，comment 仍指 covered with protocol test suite [[PCT5-KC625]]。
- CTP 1.1.10.1 與 CTP 1.1.10.5 的 limited service condition 測試說明有兩種方式：使用 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，或 rejecting normal attach reject but accepting emergency attach；後者目前 not supported。
- CTP 1.1.10.6 標示 verification ongoing。

CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status › 原文未解的問題
- unresolved：文件版次來源未標示；只看到 `CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status.xlsx` 與多個區段日期。

- unresolved：[[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 的完整產品名稱、order no.、licensing 條件與 CMWrun 文件版次來源未標示。
- unresolved：[[PCT5-KC625]] 的完整產品名稱、order no.、protocol test suite 版本與相依條件來源未標示。
- unresolved：部分 tests 仍需 external equipment、handset、Prepared TestUSIM、IVS debugging tool、in-band modem over IP support 或 IVS SUT IP address check；來源未列完整設備型號與操作流程。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 功能與測試範圍摘錄
CMX-KA098 在來源中的測試範圍包含：

- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 automatic、manual 與 test eCall。
- SIM/USIM conformance、network registration、limited service condition、eCall-only IVS cases。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、negative AL-ACK、missing AL-ACK、IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer。
- Voice link established、audio interface verification、Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance test。
- PSAP callback、clear-down、remain registered、redial / no-redial cases。
- 5GS / NR 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-5]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.523-1]] 區段支撐。
- LTE / EPS 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-1]] 與 [[3GPP TS 36.523-1]] 區段支撐。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄來源明示的 license swap mapping、capability listing 與 software maintenance PU mapping。
- 不可由 CMX-KA098 名稱或 Ident No 推論報價、可購買性、license dependency、所有客戶適用條款或 service entitlement。
- [[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 是 lossy derivative；表格欄位有缺失與 OCR 錯位，完整 test status 需回原始 PDF / Excel 確認。
- [[CMX500_Software_Maintenance_PU-Option_Mapping]] 是 Excel 轉出的 lossy derivative；原始 `.xlsx` 才是 source of truth。
- 多個測試需要 external equipment、Prepared TestUSIM、handset、IVS debugging tool、HMI interaction、engine / ignition control、in-band modem over IP support 或 IVS SUT IP address check。
- 涉及 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 NGeCall over IMS transition 的 handover cases，來源說 EU commission 尚未最終決定，因此部分 test cases 尚未實作。

R&S CMX-KA098 › License swap 來源
- 來源：[[CMW500 to CMX500OBT_License_Swap_Process]]。
- 文件月份：November 2024。
- 頁尾日期：11/6/2024；日期格式未標示。
- 文件版次：來源未標示。
- 文件分類：COMPANY CONFIDENTIAL。
- Recipient keycode：CMX-KA098。
- Recipient description：Application test IMS NGeCALL。
- Source keycode：[[R&S CMW-KA096]]（for CMWPC）。
- Source description：NGECALL APPL。
- 使用情境：[[R&S CMW500]] → [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] license swap for OBT upgrades。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 與 CMW-KA096 的關係
[[CMW500 to CMX500OBT_License_Swap_Process]] 將 [[R&S CMW-KA096]]（for CMWPC；NGECALL APPL）列為 allowed license swap 的 CMW500 source keycode，對應到 [[R&S CMX-KA098]]（for CMWPC；Application test IMS NGeCALL）。

[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 是 [[R&S CMW500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] / [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 的 Oct. 2024 NGeCall over LTE capability list；[[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 則是 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 CMX-KA098 / [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 的 NGeCall over NR/LTE capability list。兩者是不同平台 / option 組合，不應合併為同一 option。

More information [https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/automotive-ecall-testing/overview\_231772.html](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/solutions/automotive-testing/automotive-connectivity-and-infotainment/automotive-ecall-testing/overview_231772.html "https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/automotive-ecall-testing/overview_231772.html")

### Key automotive signaling test capabilities
| Capability | Automotive use case | R&S implementation / option evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 4G/5G network emulation and signaling test platform | Base platform for automotive cellular device and eCall testing over LTE and 5G NR | R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, RF parametric testing and fading propagation conditions [13]. |
| Next Generation eCall over 4G/5G IMS | Validate NG eCall voice and data transmission as emergency calling moves from 2G/3G circuit-switched networks to 4G/5G packet-switched networks | R&S and Qualcomm used R&S CMX500 to verify Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality to EN 17240:2024, including PSAP simulation and NG eCall voice and data transmission [9]. |
| R&S CMX500 + CMX-KA098 for NG eCall | Test 4G/5G NG eCall implementations under realistic network conditions | R&S states that R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [9]; CMX-KA098 is listed as enabling test software for 4G/5G NG eCall and for EN 17240:2024 [41]. |
| Hybrid eCall fallback testing | Validate that vehicles can use IP/IMS-based NG eCall over 4G/5G and automatically fall back to classic circuit-switched 2G/3G eCall when coverage or service quality degrades | Hybrid eCall testing covers reliable operation and fallback between NG eCall and classic CS eCall transport paths [2]; the source states vehicles use IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G and fall back to classic CS eCall 2G/3G when coverage or service quality degrades [3]. |
| EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 eCall compliance support | Support regulatory-oriented testing for hybrid eCall and NG eCall | R&S CMX-KA09x was updated to support EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance [1]; R&S CMX-KA099 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 18052:2025, and R&S CMX-KA098 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 [1]. |
| PSAP scenario simulation | Validate IVS-to-PSAP behavior for emergency call setup, data, voice and callback-related procedures | NG eCall verification used R&S CMX500 to simulate a PSAP and validate implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024 [9]; CMX-KA099 and CMX-KA098 completed PSAP test scenarios for EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 respectively [1]. |
| Trigger, MSD, GNSS and voice-quality validation | Validate core in-vehicle eCall behavior before certification or market launch | Manufacturers need to validate hybrid implementations can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning and provide intelligible voice quality [3]. |
| VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handover and degraded-radio scenarios | Exercise real-world cellular conditions for automotive emergency-call robustness | The listed network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation and various network scenario emulation [6]. |
| Functional tests, protocol conformity tests and type-approval preparation for IVS | Support automotive IVS implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall | cetecom advanced stated the solution is used for functional tests, protocol conformity tests and type-approval of IVS implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall [35]. |
| CEN / ETSI / 3GPP NG eCall conformance coverage | Support NG eCall over NR/LTE test execution against standards and test specifications | The CMX-KA098 / CMX-KF671B capability list covers R&S CMX500 with CMX-KA098 for CEN EN 17240, ETSI TS 103 683, 3GPP eCall over IMS and Time-Warping conformance tests [53]. |
| Detailed NG eCall procedure coverage | Exercise manual, automatic and test eCall, registration, limited service, MSD transfer/update, audio, callback, clear-down and 5GS/LTE eCall-over-IMS cases | CMX-KA098 test scope includes IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual and test eCall; SIM/USIM conformance; network registration; limited service; MSD transfer and update; IPv4/IPv6 MSD transfer; voice link; audio interface verification; PSAP callback; clear-down; and 5GS/NR and LTE/EPS eCall-over-IMS cases [61]. |
| IMS, IP and audio support for eCall | Support the voice, data and in-band modem aspects of NG eCall | CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists CMX-KA110 for IMS tests from EN 17240:2024, CMX-KA401 for TS17240 in-band modem over IP tests, CMX-KA180 for audio codecs and CMX-ZG180 as an external media endpoint for real end-to-end communication [41]. |
| Audio codec and speech-quality tooling | Support voice-link and intelligibility validation in emergency-call scenarios | CMX-KA180 provides audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice calls, including AMR-NB, AMR-WB and EVS; CMX-KA181 adds POLQA for measuring perceived speech quality; CMX-KA401 provides WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA measurements and end-to-end audio delay [18]. |
| Automation, scripting and log analysis | Automate automotive signaling and application test workflows and analyze protocol/instrument messaging | CMX500 provides CMsquares GUI for RF, functional, advanced signaling and protocol tests; CMXmars for message log analysis; CMsequencer for graphical scripting; XLAPI for Python-based scripting; and SCPI for remote control [12]. |
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Automotive need | Confirmed option / specification | Why it matters | Evidence | Gaps / risks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | 4G/5G automotive cellular and eCall signaling platform | LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, fading propagation conditions | Provides the cellular network-emulation base for NG eCall and hybrid eCall work | [13] | Formal automotive use beyond cited eCall contexts is not detailed in the passages. |
| R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA098 | 4G/5G NG eCall testing to EN 17240:2024 | CMX-KA098 enabling test software for 4G/5G NGeCall; CMX-KF671B NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS | Supports NG eCall voice/data, PSAP simulation and EN 17240:2024-oriented testing | [9], [41] | Source does not provide full test case IDs, IMS setup, GNSS setup, software versions or pass/fail details [10]. |
| R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA099 | Hybrid eCall / EN 18052:2025 testing | CMX-KA099 APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL; CMX-KF672B NGECALL TC EN18052 | Supports hybrid eCall scenarios where NG eCall and classic CS eCall paths must interoperate | [40] | Certification source does not provide full PSAP scenario IDs, acceptance criteria or complete test matrix [39]. |
| R&S CMX-KA09x eCall evaluation solution | Updated eCall compliance support | Supports EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance | Covers both hybrid eCall and NG eCall compliance context | [1] | The source does not prove coverage of all possible hybrid eCall test cases [4]. |
| R&S CMX-KA110 / KA401 / KA180 / ZG180 | IMS, in-band modem over IP and audio for NG eCall | KA110 for IMS tests from EN 17240:2024; KA401 for TS17240 in-band modem over IP tests; KA180 audio enabler; ZG180 external media endpoint | Supports the IP/IMS and voice/audio parts of automotive emergency-call validation | [41] | Exact license dependencies, versions and test package details are not fully specified [39]. |
| R&S CMX-KA181 / KA401 | Speech-quality and audio delay measurements | KA181 adds POLQA; KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA and end-to-end audio delay | Useful for validating intelligible voice quality where required by hybrid eCall implementations | [18], [3] | KA181 coverage, standard mapping and commercial availability cannot be inferred from the passages [28]. |
| R&S CMX500 PCT / PCT5-KC625 context | Protocol conformance for eCall over IMS | CTP 1.1.0.1 is covered with protocol test suite PCT5-KC625 in the EN 17240:2024 capability list | Addresses protocol-conformance aspects beyond application-level eCall scripts | [59] | PCT5-KC625 full product details, order number and protocol test suite version are not provided [60]. |
| R&S SMBV100B eCall GNSS configuration | GNSS positioning support for eCall validation | eCall GNSS testing configuration is SMBV100B-based | Addresses the GNSS positioning element that manufacturers must maintain in hybrid eCall implementations | [46], [3] | The hybrid eCall source does not provide GNSS simulation setup details [32]. |
### Scenario cut-in recommendations
| Scenario | Recommended R&S combination supported by passages | Cut-in focus | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| Automated regression and engineering debug | R&S CMX500 with CMsquares, CMXmars, CMsequencer, XLAPI and SCPI | GUI-driven testing, message-log analysis, graphical scripting, Python scripting and remote control | Automotive-specific automation flows are not described in the passages [12]. |
### Limits
The sources also warn not to infer that CMX500 / CMX-KA09x covers all possible hybrid eCall test cases [4], and several items lack full test IDs, acceptance criteria, software versions, setup details or complete equipment dependencies [10], [39], [60], [62].

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 [[EN 18052]] 或 [[EN 17240]] 標準文本摘要。
- 來源未提供正式 certification report、certificate number、測試日期或完整 test matrix。
- 來源未列 national requirements 的國家名稱或版本。
- 不可從新聞稿推論 [[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] 已涵蓋所有 possible hybrid eCall test cases。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試情境
來源明示或列出的 network scenarios 包含：

- [[VoNR]]。
- [[VoLTE]]。
- circuit-switched fallback。
- handovers。
- degraded radio conditions。
- real-world mobile network conditions simulation。
- various network scenarios emulation。

來源沒有提供各 scenario 的 test case IDs、channel model、radio profile 或 pass/fail criteria。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 EN 17240:2024 標準摘要、conformance test plan 或 certification report。
- 來源未列 test case IDs、test conditions、network parameters、IMS setup、GNSS setup、software versions 或 pass/fail details。
- 來源未說 whether verification equals formal certification；因此本頁使用 verification，不改寫為 certification。
- 來源未提供 European Commission regulation 的正式文件編號；2026-01-01 obligation date 只能追溯到本新聞稿說法。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |
| [[R&S CMXmars]] | Message log analysis，可離線分析或在線監控 instrument messaging |
| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |
| [[SCPI]] | Remote control interface，適合 simple、standardized scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX-KA181 › 使用限制
- KA181 不需要於 basic audio measurement 或 injected WAV scenarios alone。
- OTT voice quality 不一定需要 KA181；只有 POLQA via OTT 時才加。
- 本頁只根據 configuration guide 與 features overview 記錄，不能推論 POLQA license coverage、test standard mapping 或 commercial availability。

cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其 hybrid eCall 與 Next Generation eCall test solution 已成功通過 [[cetecom advanced]] 的 certification testing。
- 來源描述 [[cetecom advanced]] 是 independent test laboratory，服務範圍包含 communication technologies、automotive、medical technology、payment & identification 等產品測試與 worldwide certification。
- 測試方案以 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester 為基礎，搭配更新後的 eCall option，以支援最新 eCall regulations and standards。
- 來源說 [[Hybrid eCall testing]] 所依據的 [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system 結合不同 transmission paths and protocols，使 eCall 能可靠到達目的地。
- 來源說實務上車輛會使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G；但在 coverage 或 service quality 降低時，可自動 fallback 到 classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- 製造商需要驗證 hybrid implementations 能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並在 [[VoNR]]、[[VoLTE]] 與 circuit-switched fallback 等多種 network scenarios 下提供 intelligible voice quality。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其 eCall evaluation solution [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] 已更新，以支援 compliance with [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] option completed Public Safety Answering Point scenario tests according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] option completed Public Safety Answering Point scenario tests according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[Thomas Reschka]] 以 [[cetecom advanced]] Senior Technical Consultant 身分表示，該 solution 用於 functional tests、protocol conformity tests，以及 type-approval of [[IVS]] implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall。
- 來源稱 test environment 可 simulation real-world mobile network conditions 並 emulation various network scenarios，用於 certifications 或 new vehicle model market launch 前準備。
- Press contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。

CMX-KA098 在來源中的測試範圍包含：

- MSD transfer、MSD update、negative AL-ACK、missing AL-ACK、IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer。
- Voice link established、audio interface verification、Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance test。
- PSAP callback、clear-down、remain registered、redial / no-redial cases。
- 5GS / NR 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-5]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.523-1]] 區段支撐。
